subject: Dashboard tile sizing issue
body: One of our dashboard tiles keeps resetting to default size every time someone else on the team edits the dashboard. Minor annoyance but happens a lot.

subject: Alert routing to Slack — is this possible?
body: We saw Dashlume advertising Slack-native alerts and wondered if Kataja has something similar, or a workaround via webhook? Currently we just get email alerts and have to relay manually.

subject: Report export cuts off long text fields
body: Comment field text is getting truncated in the report builder export, even though the field shows in full on screen. Can this be adjusted?

subject: API pagination question
body: Working on a script that pulls report data via the API and running into inconsistent pagination behaviour — sometimes returns fewer rows than the limit even when more exist. Documentation example doesn't quite match what we're seeing.

subject: Dashboard blank again
body: Finance dashboard loading blank since this morning. Need this working before my 2pm meeting.

subject: Dashboard broke again — different tile this time
body: Same dashboard, different tile now showing nothing. Second time this week. Please look today.

subject: Report won't save
body: Report builder throws an error every time I hit save. Lost 20 minutes of work. Fix this.

subject: Report builder — again
body: Now it saves but the totals row is wrong. Third issue this week with the same report. Not great.

subject: Can't add a new user
body: Trying to add a new hire and getting a generic error, no explanation. Need access set up today.

subject: Formula field broken
body: A formula field that's worked for months suddenly returns errors on every row. Nothing changed on our side.

subject: Connector down since last night
body: Main ERP connector hasn't synced since last night. Numbers this morning are stale. Please prioritize.

subject: Alerts silent for two days
body: No alerts have fired in two days despite thresholds clearly being crossed. Second module issue this month.

subject: Export stuck processing
body: Export has been 'processing' for an hour. Same day as the alerts issue — feels like something's off across the board today.

subject: Report builder error, day after yesterday's mess
body: Now report builder too. Yesterday it was alerts and exports. Please just get someone to look at the whole account.

subject: Dashboard tiles missing
body: Two tiles on the exec dashboard disappeared overnight. Need this back before end of day.

subject: Alert config reset itself
body: An alert I configured last week has reverted to default settings on its own. Second day in a row something's wrong.

subject: Export blank AGAIN. Please just fix it.
body: Blank export, third time this quarter.

subject: Connector down too
body: Now the connector's failed as well. Whole morning wasted.

subject: Report builder joining the party
body: Report builder erroring now. Three modules down before lunch.

subject: API failing, same day as everything else
body: API returning 500s. Everything's broken today, not just one thing.

subject: Now seats won't update
body: Fifth issue today. Can someone just check if something's wrong on your end platform-wide.

subject: API webhook not firing
body: Set up a webhook to trigger on new report completion but it's never fired, even though reports are completing fine. Any config we might be missing?

subject: Alert email going to wrong distribution list
body: Our weekly alert digest started going to an old distribution list a few weeks ago instead of the current one. Assuming a config somewhere reverted. Not urgent over the holidays, but wanted it on record before we're back in January.

subject: Seat usage report request
body: Could you send a breakdown of which seats are actively used vs. dormant? Reviewing our license count for the year ahead. Also still waiting on the alert distribution list issue from December.

subject: Report builder formatting inconsistent across browsers
body: A report looks fine in Chrome but the column widths are off in Firefox. Cosmetic, but a few of the team use Firefox by default.

subject: Grouped report totals off by one row
body: When grouping by region, the subtotal seems to exclude the last row in each group. Checked the raw data, it's definitely a report builder issue.

subject: Scheduled export not arriving
body: Our Monday morning export hasn't landed in the shared inbox for two weeks running, though the schedule shows as active.

subject: New connector setup — need guidance
body: Trying to connect our new inventory system and the setup wizard errors out at the credentials step. Could someone walk us through it or point to updated docs?

subject: Dashboard sharing link expired
body: The shareable dashboard link we sent to a partner company has stopped working — they get an 'expired' message. Can these be set to not expire, or extended manually?

subject: Dashboard performance — slow to load
body: Our main operations dashboard has gotten noticeably slower to load over the past couple of weeks, sometimes 15-20 seconds. Nothing changed on our end that we're aware of.

subject: Alert delivery to email group not working
body: I configured an alert to send notifications to a group email address but it appears to only be delivering to the first recipient. We have a distribution list set up for this. Is the alerts module expecting individual email addresses rather than a list? If so, what's the workaround?

subject: Date range filter defaulting to wrong period
body: The date range filter on our main operations dashboard keeps defaulting to 'last 7 days' on load, even though I've saved it set to 'last 30 days'. This has been like this for a while — is there a known issue with saved filter defaults?

subject: Duplicate alert notifications
body: Several of our configured alerts have started sending duplicate notifications — same message, two or three copies within a minute of each other. This started around Dec 28. It's generating a lot of noise for the team and people are starting to ignore the alerts, which defeats the purpose. Please investigate.

subject: Dashboard performance is really poor
body: Loading times on our main dashboard have been getting progressively worse over the past few weeks — we're at 20-25 seconds now for a dashboard that used to load in 3-4 seconds. Nothing has changed on our side in terms of data volume or configuration. I've raised performance issues before and they've been resolved, but this is now impacting daily work. It would help to understand whether there's a systemic issue rather than having to report it each time.

subject: Intermittent 500s from API
body: API's throwing 500s on 5-10% of calls, no clear pattern. Retries cover it but volume's climbing. Something wrong server-side?

subject: API response times degraded significantly
body: Following up on our previous API ticket — the 500 error rate improved but now we're seeing very high latency on API responses. p95 has gone from ~300ms to over 3 seconds. This is making our real-time dashboard refresh unusable. We're relying on the API to power several internal tools so this is having wider impact than just the BI platform. Please escalate if needed.

subject: Report builder completely broken for our account
body: As of this morning, the Report builder module is not functional for us. When I open any report or try to create a new one, the screen loads a spinner and then goes blank. No error message. I've tried three different browsers and cleared cache. This is affecting every user on our account. We have had ongoing performance and API issues over the past several months and now this. I need a response today — we cannot operate without access to our reports.

subject: Dashboard widgets showing 'no data' after connector update
body: After whatever update was pushed last weekend, several widgets on our main dashboard are showing 'no data available'. The underlying connector appears to be syncing — the status shows green — but the data isn't rendering. Report builder was down for weeks and now this. At this point every month there's something new to chase.

subject: New alert rules not saving
body: New alert rules disappear after saving — reopen the module, they're gone. Existing ones still run. Eight days is too long, please expedite.

subject: Connector sync frequency changed without notice
body: Our main data connector used to sync every hour. It's now syncing every 6 hours and I didn't change anything. Did something change in the Standard plan's sync frequency limits? If so it would have been helpful to know about this in advance.

subject: Dashboard embed code broken
body: The embed code for our dashboard has stopped working — the embedded view just shows a blank frame. This is embedded in our internal intranet. It worked until about a week ago. I've regenerated the embed code but the same issue persists.

subject: Connector fix — thank you
body: Wanted to say thanks for sorting out the bank feed connector before year-end close. We'd been half-manually pulling that into Excel as a workaround, glad to be rid of that step again.

subject: Quick connector question
body: Adding a second bank account to the feed — same setup as before or does it need a new connection?

subject: Feature idea — alert snoozing
body: Would it be possible to snooze an alert for a set period instead of just muting it outright? We get a recurring alert during month-end that isn't actionable until the close is finished.

subject: Dashboard export to PowerPoint?
body: Is there any plan to support exporting a dashboard directly to PowerPoint? We currently screenshot tiles for the monthly deck, which is a bit clunky.

subject: Export formatting for year-end
body: Year-end export has an odd decimal rounding issue on the currency columns. Not blocking yet, but need it sorted before the 20th — our controlling team is trialing Dashlume for a separate project and I'd rather not have this become a talking point there.

subject: Report builder crashed mid-edit
body: Lost half an hour of work when the report builder crashed. Please fix whatever's causing this.

subject: Export missing rows
body: Export came out with fewer rows than the report shows on screen. Needed this for a filing today.

subject: Export broken again
body: Same export issue as December, missing rows. Second time in six weeks.

subject: Dashboard won't load
body: Dashboard's been spinning for ten minutes, never loads. Need it for a meeting in an hour.

subject: Can't remove a departed user
body: Trying to remove a former employee's seat and getting an error. Still being billed for it.

subject: Report builder — same day, different bug
body: Now report builder is throwing errors too. Two issues in one day.

subject: Export timing out
body: Large export times out before completing. Worked fine last month.

subject: Dashboard numbers don't match report
body: Dashboard total doesn't match the underlying report for the same period. Second day of issues in a row.

subject: API key stopped working
body: API key that's worked for months suddenly returns unauthorized. Nothing changed on our end.

subject: Second API key also broken
body: Checked our backup key too — also failing. Both keys down same day.

subject: Seats page not loading
body: On top of the API issue, the admin seats page is also just blank now. Rough day.

subject: Alerts down, day after the API mess
body: Alerts haven't fired since yesterday. Following the API and admin issues, this is the third thing broken this week.

subject: Export corrupt file
body: Downloaded export won't open, file seems corrupted. Needed it for a client deliverable today.

subject: Dashboard filter stuck
body: A filter on our main dashboard is stuck on a value from weeks ago and won't clear no matter what we select.

subject: New hire can't log in
body: Added a new seat this morning, invite email never arrived. Need them in before end of day.

subject: Dashboard broke same day as login issue
body: Now the dashboard's also down. Two things in one morning.

subject: Connector failed overnight
body: Main connector didn't sync overnight, numbers stale this morning.

subject: Dashboard also down, same day as connector
body: Dashboard's blank too now. Same day as the connector failure — feels connected.

subject: Report builder error before year-end close
body: Report builder throwing an error on our year-end template. Bad timing, need this fixed today.

subject: Dashboard access broken for whole team
body: Nobody on our BI team can load dashboards since this morning — same error for everyone. Enterprise account, need this prioritized.

subject: Admin panel unresponsive, same morning as dashboard outage
body: Admin panel is also timing out. Given the dashboard issue too, wondering if something's wrong platform-side today.

subject: Alerts not sending — third thing today
body: Alerts haven't gone out since this morning either. Three modules affected in one day is unusual for us.

subject: Second alert issue, same day
body: Different alert rule also silent. Please have someone look at the whole alerts service, not just one rule.

subject: API errors continuing from Tuesday
body: Following up from Tuesday's outage — API calls are now failing intermittently. Want to make sure this is actually root-caused, not just patched.

subject: Report builder timing out on large reports
body: Our largest quarterly report now times out before rendering. Worked fine last quarter.

subject: Connector failure, same morning as report builder issue
body: Data connector also down as of this morning. Second thing today.

subject: Second connector also affected
body: Checked our other connectors — a second one is failing too. Please check if this is systemic.

subject: Exports failing since Tuesday's issues
body: Exports have been unreliable since the connector problems earlier this week. Not sure if related but flagging.

subject: Report builder still not right
body: Report builder issue from Tuesday isn't fully resolved — still slow on large reports, just not timing out anymore.

subject: Bulk seat update failing
body: Trying to update seat roles for six people at once, the bulk action fails partway through with no clear error.

subject: Individual seat update also broken now
body: Tried updating one seat at a time instead — that's failing too now. Whole admin function seems off today.

subject: Dashboards down, same day as admin issues
body: Now dashboards as well. Third issue today, all within a few hours.

subject: API rate limiting too aggressive
body: Following up from Thursday — API is now rejecting normal-volume calls as rate limited. This wasn't happening before.

subject: Export queue stuck, same day as API issue
body: Export queue hasn't moved in 40 minutes. Same day as the API problem — hoping these are related and get fixed together.

subject: Exports blank
body: Scheduled exports came through completely blank this morning.

subject: Alerts also affected, same morning
body: Alerts didn't fire either. Second issue in one morning again.

subject: API down too — third thing today
body: API is returning errors now as well. Please check if there's a wider incident happening.

subject: Connector issue continuing from yesterday
body: Connector sync still failing, following yesterday's export and API problems. Would like a summary of what happened once it's fixed.

subject: Seat error — first issue in a while
body: Been quiet for a couple months, but now getting an error trying to add a seat for a new starter. Need it working before Monday.

subject: Seat limit reached, need guidance
body: We've hit our seat limit but I'm not sure if the right move is upgrading the plan or removing dormant seats first. Can someone walk me through the options?

subject: Alert configuration confusing
body: Trying to set up an alert based on a custom field but the setup UI doesn't seem to let me select it. Might be user error, might be a bug.

subject: Connector sync frequency question
body: Is there a way to increase our connector sync frequency beyond hourly, or is that fixed per plan tier?

subject: Report builder — nested grouping not working as expected
body: Trying to group a report by two levels (region, then product) and the second level just isn't applying. Might be a documentation gap on our end, but wanted to check.

subject: Export file naming
body: Is there a way to customize the file naming pattern for scheduled exports? Currently they all come out with the same generic name which is a hassle to sort.

subject: API documentation out of date
body: Noticed the API docs for the reports endpoint still reference a parameter that seems to have been deprecated. Not blocking, just flagging for whoever maintains the docs.

subject: Seat reassignment for maternity leave cover
body: One of our analysts is going on leave and we need to temporarily reassign her seat to the covering colleague. What's the process?

subject: Dashboard filter not saving
body: Every time I set a filter on the finance dashboard and come back to it later, it's reset to default. Happens consistently.

subject: Connector for new bank added
body: We switched banks at year-end and need the new one connected. Can you point me to the setup steps?

subject: Old bank connector still pulling data
body: The old bank connector we thought was disabled is still running and duplicating some transactions in our reports.

subject: Report builder currency symbol wrong
body: A report is showing SEK symbol on what should be EUR figures. Data itself looks correct, just the display.

subject: Export decimal separator
body: Exports use a period as decimal separator but our downstream system expects a comma. Is this configurable?

subject: Connector paused unexpectedly
body: Noticed our main connector shows as paused though nobody on our team paused it. Restarted manually but wanted to flag.

subject: API credentials rotation question
body: What's the recommended process for rotating API credentials without breaking scheduled jobs? Want to do this cleanly before year-end.

subject: SSO setup for new employees
body: We're rolling out SSO more broadly — can you confirm which seat roles support it, and if there's a bulk way to enable it for existing users?

subject: Alert digest formatting
body: We looked at Storsund BI's alert digest layout during a recent vendor comparison exercise and it groups by severity, which is nice — is anything similar planned for Kataja's digest? Ours is just a flat list currently.

subject: Alert export to spreadsheet
body: Would like to export our full alert history to a spreadsheet for an internal audit — right now we're rebuilding it manually in Excel from screenshots, which isn't great.

subject: Export job hanging in 'processing' state
body: A large export job has been stuck in 'processing' status for over two hours. No progress indicator, no error. Can you check the job queue? The export ID is visible in our account if you need it.

subject: Scheduled export format changed unexpectedly
body: Our scheduled daily export changed from semicolon-delimited to comma-delimited at some point this month without any change on our side. This broke our downstream processing script. What happened and can we lock the format going forward?

subject: Alert configuration disappeared after account update
body: After whatever account change happened on March 31st — I assume a plan change or something on your side — about half of our alert configurations are missing. Gone completely. This is the second time we've had configurations lost to a platform event and it's really not good enough. We need these restored and an explanation of what happened.

subject: Report builder — pivot table not working properly
body: The pivot table view in the Report builder is behaving incorrectly — subtotals are wrong and some row groups are collapsing when they shouldn't be. This started after the update in mid-May. We've been raising issues fairly regularly this year and the response times have been frustrating. We need this looked at quickly as our monthly reporting cycle runs this week.

subject: Exports completely broken — nothing is generating
body: Every export attempt is failing as of June 4. Manual exports, scheduled exports — all fail silently. No files generated, no errors shown. This is completely blocking our reporting workflow. I expect a response today, not in a week. We still have the open Report builder ticket from last month that has not been resolved either. The state of reliability right now is genuinely unacceptable.

subject: Connector dropping rows during sync
body: We're noticing that the row count in the platform doesn't match our source system after a sync — we're consistently losing around 200 rows per run. The connector completes without errors. This is causing our reports to show incorrect totals. Given the export issues from earlier this month, our confidence in data integrity here is low. Please investigate.

subject: New connector for logistics data
body: We'd like to connect our logistics tracking system — is this one of the supported connectors or would it need custom setup?

subject: Dashboard layout question
body: Is there a way to pin a tile to always appear first regardless of how the rest of the dashboard is arranged? Trying to keep a key metric visible at a glance.

subject: Export file size limit
body: Hitting a file size cap on one of our larger exports and it's failing silently rather than showing an error. Can the limit be raised or at least surfaced clearly?

subject: Billing contact update
body: Need to update our billing contact ahead of the next renewal — I'll be taking that over going forward.

subject: Connector credentials expired
body: Our connector credentials expired and the reauth flow isn't picking up the new password. Might just need a nudge on your end.

subject: API usage report
body: Could you send our current API call volume for the past quarter? Trying to understand our usage pattern ahead of a plan review.

subject: Report builder freezing on large dataset
body: Report builder freezes the browser tab when working with one of our larger datasets, around 50k rows. Have to force-close and lose unsaved work.

subject: Report builder permission error for one user
body: One team member gets a permissions error trying to open a report the rest of us can access fine. Roles look identical on our side.

subject: Connector duplicate records
body: Our CRM connector is pulling in duplicate contact records after the last sync. Cleaned up manually once already but it's happening again.

subject: Report builder chart type missing
body: Trying to build a waterfall chart in a report and don't see it as an option, though I recall seeing it before. Was this removed or am I looking in the wrong place?

subject: Connector duplicates again
body: Same duplicate record issue as in January is back on the CRM connector. Might be worth a permanent fix rather than a manual cleanup each time.

subject: API integration for new forecasting tool
body: We're connecting a new forecasting tool via the API — ran into an issue with the auth flow but support got us sorted. Wanted to say the turnaround was appreciated given how new the integration is.

subject: Report builder — thanks for the quick fix
body: The nested formula issue we reported got resolved faster than I expected. Team's happy, back to normal now.

subject: Feature request: conditional formatting rules
body: Would be great to have more granular conditional formatting in the report builder — currently limited to simple thresholds. We do a lot of variance reporting where multi-condition rules would help.

subject: Alert digest customization idea
body: Following on from last year's report builder request — could alerts support a similar level of customization? Specifically grouping by department rather than just by metric.

subject: Dashboard drill-down working great
body: Just wanted to flag that the drill-down feature we started using this year has been a real time-saver for the finance team. Small issue with one tile not drilling down correctly, but otherwise very happy.

subject: Alert grouping — great addition
body: Saw the alert grouping by department rolled out — exactly what we asked for back in the spring. One small bug: grouped alerts sometimes duplicate if two rules overlap, but the feature itself is a big improvement.

subject: Export scheduling time zone issue
body: Our scheduled export runs at what looks like the wrong time — set for 8am local but arriving closer to 6am. Might be a timezone default issue.

subject: Dashboard tile color scheme
body: Is there a way to apply our brand colors to dashboard chart tiles rather than the default palette?

subject: Seat role clarification
body: Can you clarify the difference between 'editor' and 'contributor' roles? Want to make sure we're assigning the right one to new analysts.

subject: Connector setup for new data source
body: Trying to connect a new internal database as a source, getting a connection timeout during setup. Firewall rules look fine on our end as far as we can tell.

subject: Dashboard sharing permissions
body: When sharing a dashboard externally, the recipient can see more underlying data than intended. Might be a permissions default that needs adjusting.

subject: API question — batch size limit
body: What's the maximum batch size for a single API request? Want to optimize our script rather than hitting limits by trial and error.
